correctness.rationale: For n≥5 and C characteristic zero, the chart x1=1 gives F=e3+e4. Direct derivative and deletion identities show singular support exactly coordinate lines. For m=n−1 formal invariant ideal I=(e3,...,em), derivations H_r=Σz_i^r∂_i e3 have triangular Newton relations H_r≡(−1)^{r+1}(r+2)e_(r+2) modulo (e3,...,e_(r+1)), r=2,...,m−2. Since these coefficients invertible in C, I=(e3,H2,...,H_(m−2)); degree-by-degree invariant unit and tangent-to-identity support-preserving coordinate substitutions remove all terms of F beyond e3, with m-adic convergence. Independent SymPy recomputation found H2=e1e3−4e4 and H3=(e1²−2e2)e3−e1e4+5e5 in five variables. At nonvertex line points, the e2 transverse Hessian has eigenvalues n−3,−1,...,−1, giving the relative formal Morse normal form. The initial cubic/quadratic forms yield multiplicities and Hilbert–Samuel series; e4 irreducible by Gauss induction and singular locus codimension n−3≥2 imply Serre R1+S2 normality. No finite checker substitutes for the complete formal induction.
